# Mayan Origin

> Specialty coffee from Honduras, rooted in Mayan heritage. Ships worldwide.

Mayan Origin is a direct-to-consumer brand sourcing single-origin coffee from small cooperatives and artisan roasters in Honduras. Every order is packed fresh in Honduras and shipped worldwide.

## Products

### Mayan Origin Coffees (Private Label)

- **Balam (El Jaguar)** — Medium roast. Washed process. Copán, Honduras. 1,300–1,700 masl. Notes of brown sugar, toasted almond, and clean citrus finish. $52 (Whole Bean 16oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/balam/
- **Mut (El Ave Sagrada)** — Light roast. Natural process. Copán, Honduras. 1,300–1,700 masl. Notes of jasmine, orange blossom, stone fruit, honey finish. $52 (Whole Bean 16oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/mut/
- **Kukulkan (La Serpiente Emplumada)** — Dark roast. Washed process. Copán, Honduras. 1,300–1,700 masl. Notes of dark chocolate, smoky cedar, and dried cherry. $52 (Whole Bean 16oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/kukulkan/

### Mythoz Coffee Roasters

National Winner — Global Coffee Awards 2025. Direct-trade from 109+ producer families across five Honduran regions.

- **Mythoz Legacy Blend (Whole Bean)** — Medium roast. Washed. Honduras (5 regions). Up to 1,800 masl. Creamy, nutty, clean citrus acidity. $56 (16oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/mythoz-classic/
- **Mythoz Legacy Blend (Ground)** — Medium roast. Washed. Honduras (5 regions). Up to 1,800 masl. $56 (16oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/mythoz-classic/

### Café Welchez

Fifth-generation coffee farmers from Copán, Honduras.

- **House Blend** — Medium roast. Natural + Washed process. Copán, Honduras. 1,000–1,300 masl. Dark chocolate, caramel, bright citrus acidity. Crafted for espresso. $40 (Ground 12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/welchez-house-blend/
- **Santa Isabel** — Light roast. Washed process. Santa Isabel Farm, Copán, Honduras. 1,000–1,300 masl. Varieties: Parainema, Catuaí, Caturra. Sweet, acidic, chocolatey aroma. $35 (Ground 12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/welchez-santa-isabel/

### Sigua Coffee

Farming and roasting in Honduras since 2013. Regenerative agriculture, full farm traceability.

- **Finca El Zapote** — Medium roast. Washed. Finca El Zapote, Siguatepeque, Honduras. 1,550 masl. Hand-selected arabica. $38 (Ground 16oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/sigua-finca-el-zapote/

### Café Maya

Over 63 years of roasting tradition. Produced in Valle de Amarateca, Honduras.

- **Coffee Club (Whole Bean)** — Medium roast. Washed. 100% Honduran arabica. Mayan Roast profile. $33 (12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/cafe-maya-coffee-club/
- **Coffee Club (Ground)** — Medium roast. Washed. 100% Honduran arabica. Mayan Roast profile. $31 (12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/cafe-maya-coffee-club/
- **Reserva** — Medium roast. Washed. 100% Honduran arabica. Premium tier. $27 (Ground 12oz). URL: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/cafe-maya-reserva/

## Brand

- Founded to bring Honduran specialty coffee to the US market and beyond
- Mayan Origin house coffees named after Mayan gods: Balam (jaguar god), Mut (sacred bird), Kukulkan (feathered serpent)
- House coffees sourced from CAFICO and COCAFCAL cooperatives in Copán, Honduras
- Partner brands: Mythoz Coffee Roasters, Café Welchez, Sigua Coffee, Café Maya
- All products packed fresh in Honduras and shipped worldwide

## Where to Buy

All products ship worldwide from Honduras. Free Express shipping on orders over $120.

Shop: https://mayanorigin.com/shop/

About: https://mayanorigin.com/about/
Blog: https://mayanorigin.com/blog/

## Content

The Mayan Origin blog covers:
- Mayan gods and culture (Kukulkan, Ixchel, Balam, complete deity guide, cacao ceremony)
- Honduran coffee origins (Copán, Siguatepeque)
- Ancient Mayan food and drink history
- Coffee brewing guides (French press, pour over, grind size)
- Recipes (Mayan hot chocolate)
